verdict.rationale: Metorial documents dedicated adapters/providers for Vercel AI SDK (@metorial/ai-sdk), OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible providers, plus official TypeScript/Python/Go SDKs and a code example wiring a session to an adapter. LangChain and CrewAI are not explicitly named, so coverage of 'major agent frameworks' is not fully complete. Missing for 10: explicit LangChain/CrewAI adapter docs, independent hands-on confirmation of each adapter's functionality.
